author: Palliser
quote: The main characters have about as much chemistry as a plank of wood, Lucia’s actress is decent, but Jason sounds like they grabbed a guy off of the street. The graphics are pretty, the 50% of the time that the game actually runs them, it consistently struggled to even manage 20fps on a PS5 Pro. You cannot replay levels, and I’m not sure if you’d even want to, everything ranged from meh and bland to borderline insufferable game design. If you’re only after something that looks pretty, then this game will satisfy you, if you actually want a game, then you’d be far better playing almost anything else.
